sources.entry: alternativeTo - Also a very nice community. If you are looking for some alternative apps FOR Windows or another platform, check this site.

summary.name: AlternativeTo
summary.one_liner: AlternativeTo is a crowdsourced directory for finding software alternatives and recommendations across desktop, mobile, and web platforms.
use_cases: Finding alternatives to software you already use
Discovering apps for Windows, Mac, or Linux
Looking for open-source replacements for paid tools
Browsing crowdsourced software lists and recommendations
summary.what_it_does: The page is a mix of many unrelated items rather than a single product description. Its meta description says AlternativeTo recommends apps and software for Windows, Mac, Linux, iPhone, iPad, Android, web apps and other platforms by suggesting alternatives to apps users already know. The page itself is mostly a feed of third-party tool listings, user reviews, comments, and curated lists, many of which are not AlternativeTo features. The only explicit site-level claim is a note quoted from a GitHub awesome list describing it as a site with a good community for finding alternative apps.
notable: Lists and user-curated collections of software
Covers desktop, mobile, and web apps
caveats: Page text is a mixed feed of unrelated listings, reviews, and comments, so most content is not about AlternativeTo itself
Pricing details for the site are not stated on the page
